title: Draft order (agent assist)
description: Pre-drafts a dine-in order from the menu and the party's requested_items + dietary_flags, to assist the server on the manual Take-order task. Copies each chosen item's price and allergen tags from the menu so the downstream bill and allergen screen are accurate. The server reviews/edits the draft before confirming — the human owns the final order. llm kind (mirrors the wire pack's draft_rfi assist); author this capability in the wizard.
